ledger.x: 1932: Manchukuo is Japan's client from its foundation.
1932: the Xing'an lands are Japan's client with the rest of the state, from the date of their gain.
4 March 1933: Rehe is annexed to Manchukuo.
4 March 1933: Rehe joins the client state.
1 March 1934: Puyi is enthroned and Manchukuo becomes an empire.
9 August 1945: the Soviet Union invades Manchuria.
Late August 1945: the fighting ends in Manchuria; Puyi 'was captured by the Red Army'.
1945: the client relation ends with the state.

wars.name: Japanese invasion of Manchuria
wars.outcome: Japan overran Manchuria: 'At the war's end in February 1932, the Japanese established the puppet state of Manchukuo'; 'On February 27, 1932, Ding offered to cease hostilities, ending official Chinese resistance in Manchuria'; 'The occupation lasted until…

wars.name: Battle of Rehe
wars.outcome: Japanese-Manchukuo victory: Rehe was annexed to Manchukuo on 4 March 1933 and the Tanggu Truce created a demilitarised zone between the Great Wall and Beijing.

wars.name: Battles of Khalkhin Gol
wars.outcome: Status quo ante bellum on the infobox: 'enforcement of border claims in accordance with the Soviet and Mongolian interpretation'; no land changed hands between the states' own holdings.

wars.name: Soviet invasion of Manchuria
wars.outcome: Soviet victory: the page's infobox lists 'the collapse of the Japanese puppet states'; 'Most of Manchuria and Inner Mongolia are returned to the Nationalist government of China by a 1945 bilateral agreement'; the Red Army withdrew 'by 3 May 1946'.

certainty.note: The Great Wall frontier is fought over until Rehe falls (March 1933); the Xing'an lands have no boundary on any page opened.
Provincial and railway lines are administrative records; the frontier with Mongolia was disputed in 1939 (Khalkhin Gol, summer 1939 on the Manchukuo page) and stays soft.
